text:
无在场伙伴时，随机召唤一位未入狱伙伴。
全体伙伴行动1次；随后每位行动者给予{Ancient:diff()}点古神值。

随机召唤一位未入狱伙伴，替换原伙伴。
有动物园的羁绊时可共存。

造成 {Damage:diff()} 点伤害。
本回合此前触发过至少 {Threshold:diff()} 次易拉罐时，获得1层无实体。

造成 {Damage:diff()} 点伤害。
本回合此前每触发1次易拉罐，追加攻击1次。
每回合首次手动打出易拉罐牌时，获得1点能量（任意手牌位置）。
立即进入古神形态。
本场战斗，古神变身门槛固定为100。

获得 {Block:diff()} 点格挡。
从弃牌堆选择1张古神牌加入手牌。
本场战斗，古神形态持续时间+1轮；当前形态也延长1轮。
触发易拉罐时，免费追加打出该牌1次。不可叠加。
每回合第3张手动打出的牌追加打出1次。不可叠加。
召唤火星包。每次打出攻击牌后，它立即行动1次。不可叠加。

召唤山泥若。
本场战斗首次入狱时，改为立即行动3次。
召唤火星包，并选择力量或敏捷模式：行动只给予所选属性，数值翻倍。{IfUpgraded:show:随后立即行动1次。|}
召唤炫狗，对目标行动{Repeat:diff()}次。每次击杀追加1次行动，目标死亡后随机换敌。炫狗入狱时不可打出。

需要山泥若在场。
直到你的下回合开始，它的治疗改为对全体敌人造成正常治疗量{Multiplier:diff()}倍的伤害。立即行动1次。

需要山泥若在场。
对全体敌人造成其正常治疗量{Multiplier:diff()}倍的伤害，然后使其入狱。
本回合最后手动打出的非X费攻击或技能，下回合抽牌后免费追加打出1次。不可叠加。
你的回合结束时，免费自动打出3张随机全职业{IfUpgraded:show:升级过的|}格挡牌。允许重复。

召唤全部未入狱伙伴。
本场战斗，不同伙伴可共存，每种最多一位。

消耗另一张手牌。
本场战斗，炫狗伤害和格挡各增加 {Boost:diff()}（可叠加）。

造成 {Damage:diff()} 点伤害。
本场战斗，山泥若治疗增加 {Boost:diff()}（可叠加）。

施加1层虚弱和1层易伤。
本场战斗，火星包给予的力量与敏捷各增加1（可叠加）。

积攒100点变身，每次变身后门槛+25。变身清空古神值，形态中不积攒。
古神形态：免伤、伤害翻倍，持续至下回合开始；不防直接击杀。
100点变身，每次变身后门槛+25。变身清空古神值，形态中不积攒。
达到{Threshold}点时变身并清空古神值，形态中不积攒。

免伤，伤害翻倍；不防直接击杀。
再经过 {Amount} 次你的回合开始后退出。
下次变身需{Amount}点古神值。每次重新变身后门槛+25。
本场战斗，古神变身门槛固定为100。
每回合首次手动打出易拉罐牌时，获得 {Amount} 点能量（任意位置）。叠加不刷新次数。
动物园伙伴

伙伴在你的回合末行动：炫狗4伤害、4格挡；山泥若回复2生命；火星包给予1力量、1敏捷。
强化与模式会改变行动效果。入狱伙伴不能普通召回。
触发易拉罐时，免费追加打出该牌1次。
手动从手牌两端打出，结算后抽1张牌。自动出牌不触发。

If no companion is present, summon a random free companion.
All companions act once, then gain {Ancient:diff()} Ancient Meter per companion that acted.

Summon a random free companion, replacing the current one.
Zoo Bond allows different companions to coexist.

Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If you triggered Can at least {Threshold:diff()} times earlier this turn, gain 1 Intangible.
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Repeat once per Can trigger earlier this turn.
Each turn, gain 1 Energy the first time you manually play a Can card (from any hand position).
Enter Ancient Form immediately.
The Ancient Form threshold is fixed at 100 this combat.

Gain {Block:diff()} Block.
Return 1 Ancient card from your discard pile to your hand.
Ancient Form lasts 1 extra round this combat. Also extend the current form by 1 round.
When you trigger Can, play that card one additional time for free. Does not stack.
Each turn, play your third manually played card one additional time. Does not stack.
Summon Huo Xing Bao. After each Attack you play, it acts once. Does not stack.

Summon Shan Ni Ruo.
The first time it would be imprisoned this combat, it acts 3 times instead.
Summon Huo Xing Bao and choose Strength or Dexterity Mode: actions grant only that stat, doubled.{IfUpgraded:show: Then it acts once.|}
Summon Xuan Gou and have it act on the target {Repeat:diff()} times. Each kill adds 1 action; choose a random new enemy when the target dies. Unplayable while Xuan Gou is imprisoned.

Requires Shan Ni Ruo.
Until your next turn, its healing deals {Multiplier:diff()} times its normal healing to all enemies instead. It acts once immediately.

Requires Shan Ni Ruo.
Deal {Multiplier:diff()} times its normal healing to all enemies, then imprison it.
After drawing next turn, replay this turn's last manually played non-X Attack or Skill once for free. Does not stack.
At the end of your turn, auto-play 3 random {IfUpgraded:show:upgraded |}Block cards from all character pools for free. Duplicates allowed.

Summon all free companions.
Different companions can coexist this combat, one of each kind.

Exhaust another card.
Xuan Gou gains {Boost:diff()} damage and Block this combat (stackable).

Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Shan Ni Ruo gains {Boost:diff()} healing this combat (stackable).

Apply 1 Weak and 1 Vulnerable.
Huo Xing Bao grants 1 more Strength and Dexterity this combat (stackable).

Transform at 100 Meter; each new transformation raises the threshold by 25. Transforming clears Meter; none is gained in the form.
Ancient Form: immune to damage, double damage until your next turn. Direct kills still apply.
Transform at 100 Meter; each new transformation raises the threshold by 25. Transforming clears Meter; none is gained in the form.
Transform at {Threshold} Meter and clear it. No Meter is gained in the form.

Immune to damage; deal double damage. Direct kills still apply.
Ends after {Amount} more starts of your turn.
The next transformation requires {Amount} Meter. Each new transformation raises the threshold by 25.
The Ancient Form threshold is fixed at 100 this combat.
Each turn, gain {Amount} Energy on your first manual Can play (any hand position). Stacking does not refresh the trigger.
Zoo Companions

At your turn end: Xuan Dog deals 4 damage and grants 4 Block; Shan Ni Ruo heals 2 HP; Huo Xing Bao grants 1 Strength and Dexterity.
Training and modes change their actions. Ordinary summons cannot free imprisoned companions.
When you trigger Can, play that card one additional time for free.
Manually play from either end of your hand to draw 1 card after resolution. Auto-plays do not trigger Can.
